evals.name: Correlation ID Propagation & HTTP Latency Interceptor
evals.prompt: Implement NestJS middleware and an HTTP interceptor that propagates x-correlation-id on all responses and logs route execution latency in milliseconds.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds CorrelationIdMiddleware and LoggingInterceptor propagating X-Correlation-ID and logging duration in milliseconds.
assertions: Extracts or generates UUID correlation ID from incoming request headers
Sets X-Correlation-ID header on all HTTP responses
Calculates route execution latency in milliseconds
Avoids explicit 'any' types in interceptor observables and parameters

evals.name: Recursive PII & Secret Redaction with Strict Types
evals.prompt: Implement a recursive sanitizeLogPayload utility in TypeScript that scrubs passwords and tokens without using explicit any types.
evals.expected_output: Implements strictly-typed recursive sanitizer using unknown and type narrowing, replacing sensitive keys with [REDACTED].
assertions: Eliminates explicit 'any' types, accepting input as 'unknown'
Recursively scrubs nested objects and arrays
Replaces sensitive keys like password, token, and secret with [REDACTED]
Safely handles null, undefined, and primitive values without throwing

evals.name: Single-Line Structured JSON Output & Elimination of Raw console.log
evals.prompt: Refactor a backend service that uses raw console.log statements into a dedicated structured logger emitting single-line JSON records.
evals.expected_output: Replaces all console.log calls with application Logger service emitting structured JSON with timestamp, level, correlationId, and message.
assertions: Eliminates all raw console.log, console.warn, and console.error calls
Injects or instantiates application Logger service
Emits single-line structured JSON logs with correlationId and level
Attaches contextual metadata without leaking un-sanitized credentials
